verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਨਿ ਕਤ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਮੇਲੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pun kat pa(n)ch tat mel khel hoi kaise bhramat anek jon kuTa(n)b sa(n)jog hai ||

en.bdb: After wandering in many species of life, I have been able to get a chance of living a family life as a human being. When will I get this body of five elements again?

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਨਿ ਕਤ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਨਿਰਮੋਲ ਹੁਇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਭੋਗ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pun kat maanas janam niramol hui dhirasaT sabadh surat ras kas bhog hai ||

en.bdb: When will I get this invaluable birth as human being again? A birth when I shall be able to enjoy the relishments of sight, taste, hearing etc.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਨਿ ਕਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੁ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਧੁ ਪ੍ਰਜੋਗ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pun kat saadh sa(n)g charan saran gur giaan dhiaan simaran prem madh prajog hai ||

en.bdb: This is an opportunity of uniting into the knowledge, contemplation, meditation and enjoying the loving elixir-like Naam that the True Guru has blessed me with.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਚਾਖਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਲੋਗ ਮੈ ਅਲੋਗ ਹੈ ॥੨੪੩॥
verses.translit_en: safal janam gurmukh sukh fal chaakh jeevan mukat hoi log mai alog hai ||243||

en.bdb: An obedient Sikh of the True Guru endeavours to make this birth a success by living his worldly life and yet remaining aloof. He relishes and repeatedly drink deep the elixir-like Naam that the True Guru has blessed him with and thus he becomes emancipated while still alive. (243)
